name: API Testing with Robot Framework
description: Mission briefing: The Galactic Communication Network needs you. Test critical API endpoints that billions rely on. One broken authentication flow, one malformed JSON response—lives are at stake.

topics.name: HTTP Basics
topics.description: Learn the fundamentals of HTTP testing: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests, status codes, headers, and response validation.

topics.name: Authentication & Security
topics.description: Test APIs with various authentication methods: Basic Auth, Bearer tokens, API keys, and OAuth2 flows.

topics.name: JSON Validation & Schema Testing
topics.description: Master JSON response validation, JSONPath queries, schema validation, and working with complex nested data structures.

topics.name: Advanced API Testing Patterns
topics.description: Learn advanced techniques: request chaining, data-driven API tests, performance assertions, mock servers, and CI/CD integration.

learningObjectives: Understand RESTful API principles and HTTP methods
Send HTTP requests and validate responses
Parse and validate JSON data structures
Use JSONPath for precise data extraction
Implement request chaining and session management
Apply best practices for API test organization
finalProjectDescription: Build a complete API test suite for a multi-endpoint REST API with authentication, CRUD operations, and error handling
